{'text': 'iPhone Duo 係 Apple 首款可摺疊 iPhone，今日開始接受預訂。然而預訂開放僅數分鐘，預計出貨日期已經一路延後到明年。', 'paragraph_context': 'iPhone Duo, Apple’s first foldable iPhone, went up for pre-order today. Within minutes of pre-orders opening, however, estimated delivery dates started slipping all the way to next year.'}

{'text': '首批 iPhone Duo 預訂訂單預計將於 10 月 23 日送達，但只有少數夠快下單嘅幸運兒先收到貨。', 'paragraph_context': 'The first iPhone Duo pre-orders are set to arrive on October 23, but only for the lucky people who placed their order in time.'}

{'text': '截至美國東部時間上午 8 時 30 分，所有 iPhone Duo 型號嘅訂單都要延到明年先有貨。所有顏色同儲存容量組合嘅預計出貨日期都係 1 月 25 日，有啲用戶見到嘅預計出貨日期更加係 1 月 29 日。', 'paragraph_context': 'As of 8:30 a.m. ET, all iPhone Duo configurations are backordered until next year. All color and storage combinations show an estimated ship date of January 25. Some users are even seeing January 29 for their estimated shipping date.'}

{'text': '呢個情況係 iPhone Duo 需求強勁同供應嚴重不足嘅結果，不過兩者之間嘅確實比例就難以判斷。', 'paragraph_context': 'This is a combination of strong demand and severely constrained supply for iPhone Duo. It’s impossible to know the exact balance between the two, though.'}

{'text': '最高讚數留言由 Jack Mayfield 撰寫', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Jack Mayfield'}

{'text': '我喺上午 8:04 下單，獲分配到 11 月 9 至 16 日嘅送貨時段……Apple Store 應用程式喺我度直到 8:03 先至啟動到。', 'paragraph_context': "My 8:04 AM order got me a Nov 9-16 delivery window... Apple Store app didn't go live for me until 8:03."}

{'text': '喺發布會之前，已經有好多報導指出 iPhone Duo 供應緊張，因為 Apple 仍然喺度逐步提升產量。《日經亞洲》上個月嘅報導指 Apple 當時每日只能生產數百部 iPhone Duo，遠遠落後於一般 iPhone 發布時嘅產能爬坡速度。', 'paragraph_context': 'Going into the launch, there were multiple reports suggesting iPhone Duo would be in short supply as Apple was still ramping up production. A report from Nikkei Asia last month said Apple was making just a few hundred iPhone Duo units per day, significantly behind the ramp of a normal iPhone launch.'}

{'text': '隨手去 eBay 一睇，已經見到有幾十部 iPhone Duo 由炒家放售預訂，開價高達 5,200 美元。', 'paragraph_context': 'A quick glance on eBay reveals that there are already dozens of iPhone Duos available for pre-order from scalpers, asking as much as $5,200.'}

{'text': '你今朝搶到 iPhone Duo 預訂未？如果搶到，你揀咗邊個配置？預計幾時送到？歡迎喺留言區分享。', 'paragraph_context': 'Did you secure an iPhone Duo pre-order this morning? If so, which configuration did you go for? What’s your estimated delivery date? Let us know down in the comments.'}

{'text': '必買 iPhone Duo 配件', 'paragraph_context': 'Must-have iPhone Duo accessories'}

  • {'text': 'Apple 40W 動態電源轉接器（最高 60W）', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max'}
  • {'text': 'Apple iPhone Duo Folio 連支架保護套', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple iPhone Duo Folio with Kickstand'}
  • {'text': 'Beats USB-C 對 USB-C 織繩充電線', 'paragraph_context': 'Beats USB-C to USB-C Woven Cables'}
  • {'text': 'TwelveSouth HiRise 3 Deluxe MagSafe 座枱充電座', 'paragraph_context': 'TwelveSouth HiRise 3 Deluxe MagSafe Stand'}
